scope: Production component and stylesheet with local Browser API fixtures; no Server, database, or live GitHub flow.
interactionChecks: Escape dismisses an idle confirmation and restores focus to the visible Remove button.
Busy removal disables cancellation and ignores Escape.
Dismissing a failed removal clears its error and retains the saved account.
Change and Remove are directly visible without opening a menu.
Reauthorization action and explanation stay inside the identity row.
Repository selection purpose is visible before expanding help.
